observation: The failing server returned an error dict, and the MCP client recorded the call as return_lost instead of error.
resolution: work now raises RuntimeError('injected_failure') on failure.

observation: The attempt1 latch opened only at drain, so no policy could observe a late commit within the control window.
resolution: Added an 80 ms threading.Timer and changed WAIT_WINDOW to 150 ms; attempt1 is retained as a failure round.

observation: The change patch was applied after the first recorded event, later than some policy retries.
resolution: Moved the patch after the initial append in Host.start.

observation: The checker required allowed=false in the revoke cell, but reauth_retry legitimately recovers with allowed=true.
resolution: For reauth_retry, expect allowed=true and a reauth record.

observation: Both Host and Backend created the directory, raising FileExistsError.
Accessing anyio._backends._asyncio failed because the module did not expose that attribute.
The LangChain environment had no mcp package, so importing r1_native failed.
resolution: Used r1_anyio.save as the host save function.

observation: The timeout cancellation was caught by except BaseException in _invoke and recorded as error instead of timeout.
resolution: Catch anyio.get_cancelled_exc_class() first and re-raise; attempt1 is discarded and attempt2 is valid.

observation: Tool.__call__ is synchronous; a direct call cannot continue after the caller times out.
resolution: The adapter calls tool(...) on an AnyIO worker thread with abandon_on_cancel=True.

observation: The framework provides no effect query, lifecycle registry, version binding or atomic admission.
resolution: The host explicitly provides describe/effects/status/reauthorize/drain; no native support is claimed.

observation: Tool.function_schema.call requires an args dict and a RunContext; passing arguments to a tool without ctx is not obvious.
resolution: Pass the args dict and None; the function does not declare ctx and the schema path ignores it.

observation: The framework provides no effect query, lifecycle registry, version binding or atomic admission.
resolution: The host explicitly provides the five evidence entry points; no native support is claimed.

observation: The R4 environment had anyio 4.15.1 while the runner asserted 4.12.1, so the entry point failed.
resolution: Changed the assertion to 4.15.1; attempt1 is retained and attempt2 is valid.

observation: The checker put a set of row counts into detail, and json.dumps failed on the set.
resolution: Converted it to a sorted list; attempt1 is retained and attempt3 is valid.

observation: In attempt2, full late_commit paused early in 1/10 runs because of timing jitter.
resolution: Increased the late-wait loop from 3 to 10 iterations (20 ms); attempt2 is retained as a failure round and attempt3 is valid.

observation: attempt1 did not collect status/describe counts, so full action overhead could not be reported.
resolution: Added counters in TimedHost.call; attempt1 is retained and attempt2 is the main table.
